ideas.pitch: A clinical-grade mobile web app that measures heart rate via smartphone camera using rPPG and provides multi-language triage in Hindi and Chhattisgarhi for local health workers.
ideas.title: Bhilai-Pulse: rPPG Triage for Rural Health Camps
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly builds on proven winning patterns from mediscan-ai and SAGACITY, adapting clinical-grade AI triage and multilingual local awareness for regional healthcare needs in Chhattisgarh.

ideas.pitch: An AI-powered nutrition platform that scans midday meal plates using computer vision to evaluate macro-nutrient content against local dietary standards and suggests corrections.
ideas.title: AaharScan: AI Nutritionist for Chhattisgarh Public Schools
ideas.why_it_could_win: Mirrors the success of E-Foodiee-AI-Nutrition-Assistant by shifting focus to a concrete regional public health utility with measurable social impact.

ideas.pitch: A lightweight browser tool that records a 60-second voice sample and runs audio spectrogram analysis using LLMs to screen for early signs of neurological disorders.
ideas.title: VoiceNeuro: 60-Second Parkinson's Voice Screening in Hindi
ideas.why_it_could_win: Replicates the grand prize-winning audio-diagnosis approach of Timbre while adding localized language support to make the demo immediately relevant to regional judges.

ideas.pitch: An AI-powered patient acquisition and trust engine combined with a computer vision rubric to help dental clinics evaluate procedural consultation transcripts.
ideas.title: ClinicTrust: AI Patient Acquisition & Prosthodontic Simulator
ideas.why_it_could_win: Combines the proven architectures of Global-Smile and Clinical-Simulator into a practical, demo-ready workflow that appeals to judges looking for commercial viability.

ideas.pitch: A multi-agent AI system that audits automated health insurance claim rejections for algorithmic bias using verifiable prompt chains and generates an appeal package.
ideas.title: ClaimAudit: Multi-Agent Insurance Authorization Bias Checker
ideas.why_it_could_win: Follows the exact blueprint of the Google Code Cure Hackathon winner claim-bias-evaluator, leveraging multi-agent auditing for high-impact social fairness demonstrations.
